caption:
Lost: one earring, near the lift. Every society group sees this notice at least once a wedding season.

The Baguette Huggies close on a hinged snap: a gold tone hoop about 15 mm across with one row of baguettes standing along the lower front. In ruby-red, crystal, green or purple cubic zirconia. ₹1,199 a pair.

The listing's own idea is to mismatch them, one ruby-red and one green: two pairs make one mismatched pair, and a spare of each. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you. A pair counts as one piece.

[ baguette huggies · 18k gold tone plated · please return to 103 ]
first_comment: Which colour would you never lose? Ruby-red, crystal, green or purple. Every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available #NairaFlore #HuggieEarrings #WeddingGuest #DemiFineJewellery #NairaPetite
alt_text: S1 (video loop): An illustrated pink Art Deco stair window on a second-floor landing. Inside, on a cork board, a pinned notice reads NOTICE. LOST: ONE EARRING. NEAR THE LIFT. please return to flat 103. thank you. the secretary. At the left is a brass scissor lift gate: the lit lift arrives, its gate folds open, then shuts, and the lift leaves. On the outer sill stand a pair of gold-tone huggie hoops with a row of purple baguette stones along the lower front, and below the sill, 'a hinged snap, closed all the way round.' A pink paper lantern hangs at the left; a brass plate carries the Naira wordmark and 2ND FLOOR.

S2 (video loop): On a cream landing sill in a shaft of window light, four gold-tone Baguette Huggies. In the middle a ruby-red hoop and a green hoop stand side by side as one mismatched pair; a ruby-red hoop and a green hoop lie at either end as spares. Above: MISMATCH THEM. (the listing's own idea: one ruby-red, one green.) Below: two pairs make one mismatched pair, and a spare of each.

S3: Close-up photograph of one Baguette Huggie in ruby-red cubic zirconia on a cream plaster block, six baguettes held by gold-tone claws along the lower front and the hinge at the left. Text: HINGED SNAP. (shown larger.) about 15 mm across · one row of baguettes along the lower front · hinged snap closure, as listed.
S4: A model's ear and neck in profile, wearing a gold-tone Baguette Huggie with ruby-red stones, the photograph framed by a thin gold line on cream.

S5: End card on blush: a brass plate with the Naira wordmark; LANDING · SECOND FLOOR; BAGUETTE HUGGIES; [ 18k gold tone plated ]; ₹1,199 a pair; 'please return to flat 103.'; nairaflore.com; every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available.
sound: In-app (optional): a light instrumental from the Instagram audio library, no vocals, ducked under the foley. Baked foley, synthesised (p09/_build/foley.py), low: S1 0.0-1.8 the lift car's soft whirr to a stop (thunk at 1.8), 1.8-3.8 the gate's clatter as it folds, 4.4 a small ting on the glint's visible peak (measured 4.400 s), 5.2-7.2 the gate closing to its latch, 7.3-9.1 the car whirring away, under a faint landing room tone (peak -16 dBFS); S2 two soft tings on the glints' visible peaks on the mismatched pair, 1.50 ruby-red and 2.90 green (peak -23 dBFS). Both loop without a seam.
